race.description: Sapphire City Don Bartlett Bush Battler’s Cup
race.comment: VIZSTAR (7) finished ninth two runs back then did well last start but found a couple better over 1400m at Kumbia, beaten only 1.3 lengths. Meets some better types this time but another big run is on the cards. RAGING (2) lines up on the back of a 3 length fourth over 1300m at Moree. Leading contender. ARCHAIC FORCE (3) booted up from the inside draw to race on the speed only to be claimed late and finish 4 lengths away in fourth last start over 1450m at Muswellbrook. Will give backers a sight. EXTREME MERGER (1) turned in a nice effort to score two runs ago but was less impressive last time out when third over 1400m at Mudgee, beaten 3 lengths. Finds a suitable race and can play a major role.
